name: holds-check
label: Exact holds check
description: Recomputes an integer expression at n and checks that the predicate HOLDS at that n. Exit 0 = holds at this n. Target claim becomes empirically_supported (not verified — one n is not a proof).

inputs.name: expression
inputs.description: integer arithmetic over n, e.g. n*n+n+41

inputs.name: n
inputs.description: integer value of n to test
